data.one_liner: Agent framework for building client and server-side apps in Dart with generative AI.
data.what_it_does: Dartantic provides an agent framework that simplifies building client and server applications using generative AI. It supports multi-step tool calling, streaming output, typed outputs, multimedia input, media generation, embeddings, and model reasoning across multiple AI providers.
use_when: You want to build AI agents with multi-step tool calling in Dart or Flutter.
You need to switch between multiple LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Ollama.
You need MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration in your Dart project.
avoid_when: You only need basic text-to-speech or simple device-side ML tasks handled by ML Kit.
You are not using generative AI models in your application.
strengths: Supports multiple AI providers out of the box including OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Mistral, Ollama, and more.
Built-in agentic behavior with autonomous multi-step tool calling.
Supports streaming output, typed outputs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
weaknesses: Depends on a large number of underlying provider SDKs.
Requires active API keys and internet connectivity for remote model calls.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and configuring API keys for your chosen AI providers.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you specifically want to integrate Gemini models through Firebase services.
